scope: Parallel signal-event heads, added after the economic model experiment to complete the requested distinction between early turn and persistence. This does not alter the economic primary or its failed adoption rule. Retrospective exploratory research.

targets.new_negative_72h: At daily landmark when latest known settled funding>=0, first observed negative settlement during[asof,asof+72). A success before first missing hour is observed; absent success requires all72h known. Known delivery before a turn is failure. Full72h maturity purged regardless of event time.
targets.survival_168h: Existing strict pure-survival label: latestnegative & known raw24<=0, no strictly positive raw24 or delivery during next168h. Zero raw24 does not exit. Not every settlement must be negative.

features: Scenario-independent116features from this v3: existing90 + past cash-cycle, raw-cashEMA, fee/sigma and cross-venue features. No quantity feature or symbol ID. Latest complete hour asof-1.
fitting: Monthly March-November2026. Train on fully matured labels strictly before start of prior60day calibration window; calibrate sigmoid only on matured labels within last60days. All transformations fitted on train only. No test family selection.
alerts: Report ranking precision top10 daily and72h coin cooldown, AP,Brier,calibration bins, misses; repeated survival windows not independent. Threshold0.5 fixed as diagnostic, not execution rule.
adoption: Separate decision per head. No automatic production switch from retrospective metrics. Fewer false alerts and event coverage at same alert count required; long-value economic candidate remains WATCH_ONLY regardless of event scores.
